audit.whatIsWrong: diff HARD at 8/10, with breakdown.difficulty and report[14] both quoting 44.53%. The packet says Yi wins 54.58% over 262 games and flags the chart as contradicting the data.
audit.why: The page currently tells the player he loses a lane he wins, and quotes a win rate that is roughly the inverse of the real one.
audit.corrected: diff EVEN, 5/10, tone recoloured, both percentages restated at 54.58%.

audit.whatIsWrong: Row 4 (Level 6) gave Pantheon the stage in both layers even though it is the level Yi gains Highlander.
audit.why: Grand Starfall is 180s at rank 1 against Highlander's 85s — Yi gets two ults per one of Pantheon's, so level 6 is not a stage Pantheon simply owns. The mirror could not fix these cells because it believed enum edits would fail the length band; they are exempt.
audit.corrected: phases[4].side and win[4] flipped to Skill as a matched pair, with the rating and both why-texts rewritten around the 85s-vs-180s gap.

audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers credit Pantheon's PASSIVE with blocking autos. Mortal Will empowers his next spell; the block is Aegis Assault (E), it only covers damage from the FRONT, and it is a channel. Shield Vault was also never named as an auto-attack reset, and nothing said it cancels Meditate.
audit.why: 'His passive blocks your autos' tells a player the block is permanent and unavoidable. It is an 18-22s ability with a facing limit and a channel — you walk around it or wait it out. And Meditate dies to his W, which decides when Yi may heal.
audit.corrected: Every block reference moved to Aegis Assault (E) with the frontal limit stated; the W auto reset named as the wind-up tell; the Meditate cancel written into mid.
sources: enemyKit E Aegis Assault (shield, untargetable, channel; 'invulnerable to damage from the front')

edits.before: Highlander lets you dodge ganks and disengage, but his level-6 spike and global R mean he out-tempos you and can leave to snowball elsewhere.
edits.after: Highlander is 85s against Grand Starfall's 180s, so you get two ults per one of his — he still out-tempos you globally, but the 1v1 is now a read.

edits.before: Pantheon's poke and passive block shut down Yi's weak early trades.
edits.after: Comet Spear poke and Aegis Assault's front block shut down early trades.

edits.before: Through levels 4-5 his passive block and stun still beat you.
edits.after: Through 4-5 Aegis Assault's front block and his stun still beat you.

edits.before: His level-6 burst all-in with Aegis stun stays lethal to a squishy Yi.
edits.after: At 6 his Shield Vault stun bursts you, but R is 85s to his 180s.

edits.before: Pantheon dominates early: Comet Spear pokes you down, Shield Vault stuns and burst-trades, and his passive blocks your auto-attacks and Alpha Strike hits, so you lose every trade to a squishy Yi.
edits.after: Pantheon dominates early: Comet Spear pokes you down, Shield Vault stuns off an auto reset, and Aegis Assault (E) blocks damage from the FRONT only — his W wind-up is your cue to step back, not the cast.

edits.before: Grand Starfall lets him disengage or bait you, but his real threat is the level-6 point-and-click all-in with Aegis stun; don't commit — his early kit still deletes you before Highlander pays off.
edits.after: Grand Starfall is 180s at rank 1 so it is rarely the lane threat — his real one is the Shield Vault stun into an empowered Comet Spear; don't commit until your first item can survive that combo.

edits.before: Pantheon crushes Yi's early game: Comet Spear poke, Shield Vault stun trades, and his passive that blocks your autos and Alpha Strike damage mean you can't win a single trade, so hug the wave and farm.
edits.after: Pantheon crushes Yi's early: Comet Spear poke, Shield Vault stun trades, and Aegis Assault (E), which blocks damage from the front while it channels — go around it or wait it out, because you cannot trade through the front.

edits.before: He keeps the lead through level 6 — his frontloaded burst and Aegis block still threaten to delete you, and even Highlander doesn't save you from a full Shield Vault combo, so play patient until your first item.
edits.after: He keeps the lead to 6 — his frontloaded burst and the Aegis Assault front block still threaten you, and Shield Vault is a point-and-click stun that cancels Meditate mid-channel, so only heal once his W is spent.

edits.before: His Aegis blocks the first hit of your retaliation, so trading autos with him pre-items is always a losing exchange even with Wuju Style up.
edits.after: Aegis Assault (E) blocks damage from the front while it channels, so trading autos into it is a losing exchange even with Wuju Style up.

edits.before: Pantheon owns levels 1-6 (peaking at 3); the lane is even at first item and tilts to you at two items as his spear falls off and your on-hit comes online.
edits.after: Pantheon owns levels 1-5 (peaking at 3); level 6 is a read, the lane evens at first item and tilts to you at two items as your on-hit comes online.

edits.before: The lane hinges on Alpha Strike's untargetability dodging his W stun and empowered Q; his Aegis passive blocking your first auto negates your retaliation; and Highlander's slow immunity + move speed letting you escape his all-in and ganks. Meditate out-sustains his poke once his spear scaling falls off.
edits.after: The lane hinges on Alpha Strike's untargetability dodging his W stun and empowered Q; on Aegis Assault (E) blocking damage from the front, so you go around it or wait out the channel; and on Highlander's slow immunity and move speed to escape his all-in and ganks. Meditate out-sustains his poke once his spear falls off.

edits.before: It's an 8/10 because Pantheon attacks every one of your weaknesses at once: he out-ranges you (Q), point-and-click catches you the instant your only escape ends (W), and his passive negates your auto-reliant damage — all during the exact levels you're at your weakest. The 44.53% win rate reflects how often Yi simply never reaches his scaling.
edits.after: It's a 5/10 because Pantheon attacks every one of your weaknesses at once: he out-ranges you (Q), point-and-click catches you the instant your only escape ends (W), and Aegis Assault blanks your frontal damage — all during the exact levels you're weakest. Yi still takes it 54.58%, because every window after that one is his.

edits.before: HARD (8/10) — Pantheon stomps the early game and you only win by surviving to two items; lolalytics 44.53% confirms Yi rarely gets there cleanly.
edits.after: EVEN (5/10) — Pantheon stomps the early game and you win by surviving to two items; the 54.58% win rate says Yi usually gets there.
